name: AgentsView Task Control Plane
goal: Build a thin local-first, event-driven agent task control plane with a Kanban board, harness-neutral agent management, compact context, session intelligence, task types, phases, gates, and metrics.
repoContext: Clean AgentsView main checkout: Go daemon/CLI, SQLite archive, REST/SSE server, provider parsers, and Svelte 5 frontend. Task state will use a separate local tasks.db.

stories.title: Add the Kanban and agent UI
Connect tasks, sessions, intelligence, and runtime
Activate managed runtime from the daemon
Expose task detail and aggregate metrics
Add ticket detail, live session, and metrics dashboard routes

eventLog.event: User directed remaining questions be inferred and implementation begin with subagents.
PRD, architecture, and story gates auto-approved.
Integrated storage/API, Kanban UI, harness runtime, CLI/MCP, and dispatch slices.
User established lifecycle authority: implementing agents own Understand through Verify; coordinator owns only gated Verify to Done.
Created and assigned three full-lifecycle dogfood tickets for runtime activation, metrics API, and ticket detail/dashboard views.
User expanded ticket detail to require the actual active or linked agent session and bounded live activity.

notes: Single-user and local-machine v1; no hosting.
